summary_en: Correction to reference data disclosed 2024-06-23. Shares outstanding (ex-treasury) restated to 12,715,840; treasury holdings restated to 23,856 shares. J-ESOP trust holdings (452,800 shares) explicitly excluded from treasury count. No change to buyback program itself.
summary_jp: 2024年6月23日開示の参考情報を訂正。発行済株式総数（自己株式を除く）を12,715,840株に、自己株式数を23,856株に改める。J-ESOP信託保有分452,800株は自己株式に含めず。買付プログラム本体に変更なし。

summary_en: 380,000 shares (3.1% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 24 Jun 2026 at ¥1,705/share (closing price 23 Jun 2026). Upper limit ¥647.9M. Single-day purchase window (8:45 AM JST). Partial or full non-execution possible depending on market conditions.
